别名

  • Little Sisters Sausage

あらすじ

I’m Yui. I’m just a normal girl who really loves her big brother. When I’m alone with my big brother my heart always beats really hard. I wake my sleepyhead brother up in the morning and we eat together and go to school together. Tee-hee, it kinda makes me feel like we’re newlyweds! But then one day I noticed something.. There was a sausage growing in my pants! It got all big when I touched it, and when I touched it some more it got all hard! What’s going on? What should I do!? I can’t tell my friends about this. Hey, big brother, look in my panties…do you see anything weird?

Tentaku takes over Kouichi’s mind, and with his loins transformed into a tentacle monster, Kouichi repeatedly assaults various women in order to heal Tentaku’s wounds. In the process, he slowly transforms into a monster himself.

  • 日本語名: 剣・魔・凌・辱
  • 英語名: Ken Ma Ryou Joku

别名

  • Sword - demon - abuse

あらすじ

Our hero Itsuki is the most average joe you could ever expect to meet. On the last train of the night, he dozes off. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a mysterious forest he has never seen before.

As Itsuki wanders about the forest looking for a way out, he stumbles on a lady warrior who has been trapped by a slime monster. Evidently, this is not present day. This is a world of fantasy and heroism like the ones you get in games or anime!
